name: help-articles
description: Check and fix your help articles and saved replies against approved policies, with exact replacements and source references. Use when you want to check articles after a policy change, update saved replies from release notes, or find confusing help content from tickets. Supply policy or release documents, article and saved-reply exports, and optional tickets with unnecessary private details removed. Keeps dates, plans, language or location settings and versions separate. Unverified ticket fixes remain proposals. Requires content-owner review. Not for legal certification, general ticket triage, publishing, sending or live helpdesk access. Fetches nothing from the network. No accounts or paid APIs are required.
